verdict.rationale: Railway's main configuration model is a visual canvas, and the only hint of config-as-code is the line "YAML optional" (railway-docs-3). Instant rollback to previous deployments (railway-docs-13) covers deploy versioning, but nothing shows a single file defining the whole multi-service architecture. Missing for 10: documentation of a config file covering the entire architecture (services, databases, networking), evidence the file is versioned in the repo and drives deploys, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
